title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for AI Assistant and Chatbot Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to an AI assistant app: model access without API keys, chat that streams, voice and camera input, answers from your own documents, and a paywall.
body_markdown: Not with Blink. Apps built on it use the platform's gateway, so there are no keys to store or leak. Most other builders in this ranking use AI for building only, and leave app-side model access to you.
